verdict.rationale: Composio explicitly documents white-labeling: swapping logo/name and restyling the auth page, configurable via dashboard (composio-docs-8, composio-docs-22, composio-docs-32). However, evidence does not confirm bringing your own OAuth app credentials (client ID/secret) as part of this white-label flow versus using Composio's shared OAuth apps — the auth_config references (composio-docs-23) suggest custom auth configs exist but the story's 'own OAuth app credentials' aspect isn't explicitly tied to the white-labeling docs. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that white-labeled flow uses platform-engineer's own OAuth client ID/secret, independent/hands-on corroboration of the branding customization actually working end-to-end.
